title: A clone does not inherit the first operator's consent
statement: A project carrying a committed research choice, opened on a machine with no local consent record, reopens the prompt and does not use that host's credential until it is answered. Changing the provider or the research choice likewise reopens the relevant prompt.
notes: ⚠️ NOT EVALUATED, 2026-09-22. EVD-0126 is component proof for TSK-0034: clone controls for project-local and per-user state, negative controls for a force-added record (R1), a staged but uncommitted removal (R5) and an unignored record in a parent repository (R6), and the no-Git limit (R4). EVD-0127 is component proof for TSK-0035: the research choice writer clears this host's research grant before it writes the choice, so Tavily to none to Tavily asks again, and a failed probe changes nothing. EVD-0128 is component proof for TSK-0036: the model selection writer clears this host's model-use grant before it writes a changed selection, refuses the change when the grant cannot be cleared, and changing away and back reopens approval. This criterion is evaluated once setup (TSK-0060) and the launch path (TSK-0037) exercise these writers and grants.
